capabilities: Browse recent Markdown notes and Canvas boards in one sidebar
Pin, search and filter notes by type, folder and tag
Jump to a specific date without hiding other notes
Open linked .md and .canvas documents from Canvas cards
Drag Markdown notes onto a Canvas board on desktop
extras: Cross-device edit-time sharing relies on the user's existing vault sync service and is off by default; the README notes a few file-menu labels remain in Chinese in English mode.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer organizes notes by folder, making it slow to get back to what you were recently working on.
summary: Sidebar that lists recently edited Markdown notes and Canvas boards as preview cards with pinning, date jumps, search, filters and multiple layouts.
